source: UCI Machine Learning Repository - Cleveland Clinic Foundation
positive_label_meaning: Presence of Heart Disease (> 50% diameter narrowing)

feature_descriptions.cp: Chest pain type (0: typical angina, 1: atypical angina, 2: non-anginal pain, 3: asymptomatic)
feature_descriptions.trestbps: Resting blood pressure in mm Hg on admission to the hospital
feature_descriptions.fbs: Fasting blood sugar > 120 mg/dl (1 = true; 0 = false)
feature_descriptions.restecg: Resting electrocardiographic results (0: normal, 1: ST-T wave abnormality, 2: probable or definite left ventricular hypertrophy)
feature_descriptions.thalach: Maximum heart rate achieved during exercise stress test
feature_descriptions.oldpeak: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest
feature_descriptions.slope: The slope of the peak exercise ST segment (0: upsloping, 1: flat, 2: downsloping)
feature_descriptions.ca: Number of major vessels (0-3) colored by fluoroscopy
feature_descriptions.thal: Thalassemia blood disorder (1: normal, 2: fixed defect, 3: reversible defect)

description: 14 clinical attributes used to predict presence of heart disease in patient.
known_limitations: Sample size is ~303 patients; predominantly male demographic in Cleveland clinic (1988).
